fullPassage: Baarle is a small border village where areas of Belgian land are scattered within the surrounding Dutch territory. To make things more confusing, there are some Belgian areas within the Dutch territory that contain smaller Dutch properties. It is one of only a few places in the world that have such a complicated border. In 1995, the Belgian and Dutch governments decided to clearly mark the unusual border with a line on the ground. Which country do you live in if your house is divided by this line? This is determined by where your front door is! So if the Dutch annoyed you last week, all you have to do is move your front door to relocate to Belgium.
